step_by_step_approach: List all Formula 1 seasons that occurred from the year 2001 onward.
Within each season, keep only the drivers who earned points.
For each season, sum the points of the point‑scoring drivers for each constructor.
Determine the smallest summed point total among constructors for that season.
Identify the constructor(s) whose summed points equal that smallest total in each season.
Count how many seasons each constructor appears as having the smallest summed points.
Rank the constructors by these counts from highest to lowest.
Select the five constructors with the highest counts.
